mechanism: Late-bind current-position opportunity after choosing task with original catalog; fixed task identity within decision, not global path identity.
development: Same52 development scenarios x both rounding modes; round8 failures reused only as development diagnostics.
selection: Select lowest bounded development mean among complete/audited variants with mean lower and p95 <= REF in both rounding models. Then lock and generate fresh ordinary/outer cases; same gates in every validation batch, no fallback promotion from comparators.
